Messages.Author: Legbiter
Messages.Body:
As the sun sets over the Solent you are reminded that Turner lived here,
and painted his beautiful skyscapes from the downs that sandwich this city
of grey ships to north and south. Unless you're one of the city's numerous
undead, that is. First of all it would fry you, and second of all you have
other worries as the shadows lengthen in your crypt. Anarchy is abroad,
and the Sabbat waxes strong .... dark brothers and sisters, it is time to
reclaim the night!

Where: Second Byte, Albert Rd, near the King's theatre. Catch a number 13
or 17 bus from outside the railway station, or email
james.m...@port.ac.uk for a map if coming by car.

When: A sunday in early May, starting at 11am. Firm date and time nearer
the time.

Rules: DCI golden tenets [no repeat actions, no vote-pushing]. If using
mixed Jyhad and Vampire-backed cards, use opaque card backs OR a 60-40
card split.

Entry Fee: Ł3.00. Prizes to be decided, but there will be something for
everyone.

Do come along if you can. There are a couple of strong play-groups in the
city and Southampton has others, including Rob Treasure who is the
European VTES champion and a FIENDISHLY good player. James Coupe, Prince
of England has promised to descend from the north, or anyway the midlands,
to wreak havoc amongst us. Probably if you live around Brum and James has
passed his test, he might give you a lift. Also I hope to entice Michael
Beer over from Dortmund, whose performance in the JOL tournament entitles
him to claim a place among the top five players in the world! O, and there
are LOTS of really crap players like me so don't be frightened!!!

Legbiter wrote:
> Rules: DCI golden tenets [no repeat actions, no vote-pushing]. If using
> mixed Jyhad and Vampire-backed cards, use opaque card backs OR a 60-40
> card split.

DCI rules and Golden Tenets are not the same thing.

DCI Rules (official tounament rules):
* No Repeat Actions
* Delayed Vote Replenishment

Golden Tenets (house rules):
* No Repeat Actions
* No Vote Pushing

--
